svg.desc: In one constructed example, region 1 switches from 0.2 to 0.8 before region 2. In another, region 1 briefly reaches 0.8 and returns to 0.2 while region 2 stays at 0.2. Both absolute regional differences are 0, 0, 0.6, 0 and 0.
